meaning.english: She is reached by contemplation, cuts worldly bondage, and blesses devotees.
meaning.kannada: ಧ್ಯಾನದಿಂದ ಅರಿಯಬಹುದಾದ ಆಕೆ ಸಂಸಾರಬಂಧವನ್ನು ನಿವಾರಿಸಿ ಭಕ್ತರಿಗೆ ಮಂಗಳ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ.

names.english: The consort of Bhava (Śiva); the mother who gives life

essential_meaning.en: The consort of Bhava (Śiva); the mother who gives life

traditional_interpretation.en: Bhavānī points to the Goddess as Śiva’s inseparable power, and as the source of living existence.
traditional_interpretation.kn: ಭವಾನಿಯು ಶಿವನ ಅವಿಭಾಜ್ಯ ಶಕ್ತಿಯೂ ಜೀವದ ಮೂಲವೂ ಆಗಿದ್ದಾಳೆ.

components.en: The consort of Bhava (Śiva); the mother who gives life

names.english: She who is approached through contemplation

essential_meaning.en: She who is approached through contemplation

traditional_interpretation.en: Bhāvanā is attentive contemplation; the name directs practice inward rather than only toward external ritual.
traditional_interpretation.kn: ಭಾವನಾ ಎಂದರೆ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಚಿಂತನೆ; ಈ ನಾಮವು ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಆಚರಣೆಯ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಅಂತರಂಗದ ಸಾಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

components.en: She who is approached through contemplation

names.english: The axe that cuts the forest of worldly becoming

essential_meaning.en: The axe that cuts the forest of worldly becoming

traditional_interpretation.en: The forest symbolizes entanglement in repetitive becoming; the axe is the liberating power of discernment.
traditional_interpretation.kn: ಅರಣ್ಯವು ಸಂಸಾರಬಂಧದ ರೂಪಕ; ಕೊಡಲಿಯು ವಿಮೋಚಕ ವಿವೇಕಶಕ್ತಿಯ ಸಂಕೇತ.

components.en: The axe that cuts the forest of worldly becoming

names.english: She who loves what is auspicious

essential_meaning.en: She who loves what is auspicious

traditional_interpretation.en: The name joins auspicious goodness with the Divine Mother’s affection.
traditional_interpretation.kn: ಮಂಗಳಮಯವಾದುದರ ಮೇಲಿನ ದೇವಿಯ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯನ್ನು ಈ ನಾಮವು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

components.en: She who loves what is auspicious

traditional_interpretation.en: Auspiciousness is not merely something she gives; it belongs to her very nature.
traditional_interpretation.kn: ಮಂಗಳವು ಅವಳು ಕೊಡುವ ವರ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ; ಅವಳ ಸ್ವಭಾವವೇ ಮಂಗಳಮಯ.

names.english: Bestower of good fortune upon devotees

essential_meaning.en: Bestower of good fortune upon devotees

traditional_interpretation.en: The devotional reading describes her grace as the source of spiritual and worldly well-being.
traditional_interpretation.kn: ಭಕ್ತಿಯ ಪರಂಪರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಕೆಯ ಅನುಗ್ರಹವನ್ನು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಲೌಕಿಕ ಕ್ಷೇಮದ ಮೂಲವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಾರೆ.

components.en: Bestower of good fortune upon devotees
